name: fbx-port
description: A resumable bulk port (roadmap 164000) over the generated tree fixtures/data/port, written by python -m ac_train.fbxwrite. Its list has 9 lines, counted by hand. Imported, 5: PackA/Walks/walk.fbx (1 clip); takes.fbx (3 clips, two of them from its second take, which the pilot's files had refused); turned.fbx (1, turned to face -Y); hang.fbx (1, raised 0.5 m and left there); sunk.fbx (1, lowered 0.5 m and moved back up to z = 0). Duplicate, 1: PackB/Walks/walk.fbx has walk.fbx's bytes. Refused, 2: swapped.fbx (left and right named the wrong way round), not-humanoid.fbx. Pending, 1: missing.fbx isn't there, so it has no outcome, as when a drive is away. So 7 clips. The second run skips the 8 finished and does nothing. The third, with retry_refused, tries the 2 refused again, they come out the same, and it adds nothing. Refused: a list that isn't there, and an output folder inside the repository.
